text: The outward restore of the prior status to COLLINS and EFS is one hop on the restore operation rwb-integration publishes, with the case ID, the prior status, the return reason and the rule version in the request and the restored status and a restore reference in the answer, inside the 2 s budget, with an idempotency key of the case ID and the rule version. Until the operation name, the request and answer fields and the error set are published they are held as the placeholder of CG-B2-S2-004-1, the client is built against the documented use and a fake, and this legacy key carries no class C dependency to RWB-P2-E1007-CON because its plan row names none.
why: The legacy criteria require the case to be returned to the status it held in COLLINS, DP-16 puts the external estate behind rwb-integration's contract, and no source publishes the operation, its request, its answer or its error set.

text: The prior status is a field of the case answer that the parent CaseWorkflow forwards to the child, not a table read and not a REST read: rwb-case holds the case, its status and the status it held before the restructure, and this stage reacts to OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER, records the prior status it is given and reports RETURNED_TO_COLLINS. A case answer with no prior status stops the branch: the stage does not invent one, reports the gap to the parent and raises a MSG-GEN-006 incident. The case statuses of R-RES-17, R-RES-18 and R-RES-20 are moved by the parent and never by this service.
why: Both legacy criteria name a case status and a prior status, the split puts every case status with rwb-case, and no source publishes a prior-status field on the case or on the treatment.

text: The PriorStatusRestore element carries priorStatus, returnReason, returnedAt, ruleVersion, offerValidUntil, restoreReference and ruleId, with the first four required and the last three optional, and its field identifiers, its artefact coordinates and its publication channel are held as the placeholder of CG-B2-S2-004-2. returnReason takes the two rule events CUSTOMER_DECLINED and OFFER_EXPIRED and no other value; offerValidUntil maps to DF-TRT-010 and the consumer's outcome fields map to DF-TRT-013 and DF-TRT-014; no band, score, COLLINS status table or free-text reason is declared.
why: No schema, field identifier or contract channel exists for a restore element, and the contract cannot be published without a written field list and a bounded vocabulary.
